name: aliphatic aldoxime to diphosphate
summary: A 6-step route from aliphatic aldoxime to diphosphate(3−), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: aliphatic aldoxime dehydratase
reactions.equation: an aliphatic aldoxime = a nitrile + H2O

reactions.name: nitrilase
reactions.equation: a nitrile + 2 H2O = a carboxylate + NH4(+)

reactions.name: a carboxylate + ATP + CoA = an acyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate
reactions.equation: a carboxylate + ATP + CoA = an acyl-CoA + AMP + diphosphate

reactions.name: acylphosphatase
reactions.equation: an acyl phosphate + H2O = a carboxylate + phosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: 5'-acylphosphoadenosine hydrolase
reactions.equation: a 5'-acylphosphoadenosine + H2O = a carboxylate + AMP + 2 H(+)

reactions.name: glutamine N-acyltransferase
reactions.equation: an acyl-CoA + L-glutamine = an N(2)-acyl-L-glutamine + CoA + H(+)

reactions.name: N-acyl-D-aspartate deacylase
reactions.equation: an N-acyl-D-aspartate + H2O = D-aspartate + a carboxylate

reactions.name: aspartate--ammonia ligase (ADP-forming)
reactions.equation: L-aspartate + NH4(+) + ATP = L-asparagine + ADP + phosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: tropine acyltransferase
reactions.equation: tropine + an acyl-CoA = an O-acyltropine + CoA + H(+)

reactions.name: glutamine--tRNA ligase
reactions.equation: tRNA(Gln) + L-glutamine + ATP = L-glutaminyl-tRNA(Gln) + AMP + diphosphate

reactions.name: phenylalanine racemase (ATP-hydrolyzing)
reactions.equation: L-phenylalanine + ATP + H2O = D-phenylalanine + AMP + diphosphate + H(+)

reactions.name: L-tyrosyl-[protein] + L-ascorbate + L-lysyl-[protein] + 2 O2 = glycyl-[protein] + (S)-2...
reactions.equation: L-tyrosyl-[protein] + L-ascorbate + L-lysyl-[protein] + 2 O2 = glycyl-[protein] + (S)-2-amino-6-oxohexanoyl-[protein] + 4-aminobenzoate + L-dehydroascorbate + 2 H2O + 2 H(+)
